name: SENTINEL
tagline: FRED indicator monitor with threshold alerts, deployed to AWS via IaC

children.title: Economic data inputs
children.summary: Pulls three U.S. economic indicators from the St. Louis Fed's FRED API whenever an ingest is triggered.

children.title: FEDFUNDS
children.summary: Federal Funds Rate.

children.title: CPIAUCSL
children.summary: Consumer Price Index, the inflation series.

children.title: UNRATE
children.summary: Unemployment rate.

children.title: Daily scheduled ingest
children.summary: A GitHub Actions cron called POST /ingest every day at 08:00 UTC while deployed. Switched off once the server was torn down.

children.title: Ingestion ETL
children.summary: Fetch, clean and upsert each series. Built so running it twice never creates duplicate rows, because automated jobs retry.

children.title: Fetch latest 24
children.summary: Asks FRED for the 24 most recent observations per series, newest first, and fails loudly on HTTP errors.

children.title: Clean values
children.summary: Skips FRED's '.' placeholder for missing data and converts the rest from strings to floats.

children.title: Postgres upsert
children.summary: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT on (series_id, date) updates existing rows instead of duplicating them.

children.title: All-or-nothing commit
children.summary: Each series is one transaction: commit on success, roll back everything on any error, always close the session.

children.title: PostgreSQL
children.summary: Stores history so the API serves from the database and never depends on FRED being up for reads.

children.title: observations
children.summary: One row per series per date with value and fetch time. A unique constraint backs the upsert.

children.title: thresholds
children.summary: One max-change rule per series, set through the API.

children.title: alerts
children.summary: Each fired alert with the value, previous value and the size of the change.

children.title: Threshold alerts
children.summary: After each ingest, compares consecutive observations against each series' threshold and saves an alert when the move is too big.
children.detail: Plain rule-based checks, not prediction. The goal is spotting when an indicator moves enough to deserve attention.

children.title: Consecutive-pair check
children.summary: Walks the last 24 observations and measures each month's change from the one before.

children.title: Both directions
children.summary: Uses the absolute change, so a sharp drop fires just like a sharp rise.

children.title: No duplicate alerts
children.summary: Loads existing alert dates into a set first, so re-running the check never fires the same alert twice.

children.title: FastAPI service
children.summary: REST API with read endpoints open and write endpoints behind an API key. Interactive docs come from OpenAPI.

children.title: GET /health
children.summary: Deep health check that runs SELECT 1 and returns 503 if the database is down, so a load balancer would actually notice.

children.title: GET /metrics
children.summary: The 100 most recent observations.

children.title: GET /alerts
children.summary: The 50 most recent fired alerts.

children.title: POST /ingest
children.summary: Runs the whole pipeline: ingest all three series, then check alerts. Returns rows per series and new alerts.

children.title: POST /thresholds
children.summary: Creates or updates the max-change threshold for a series.

children.title: Security review
children.summary: Reviewed auth, secrets, exposed ports, write endpoints, deploy config and failure behavior before launch, and fixed what it found.

children.title: API key on writes
children.summary: POST routes require an X-API-Key header checked in a FastAPI dependency. Missing or wrong key gets a 401.

children.title: Fail-fast secrets
children.summary: The app refuses to start if the database URL, API key or FRED key is missing from the environment.

children.title: Secrets in GitHub Secrets
children.summary: SSH key, host and API key live in repo secrets, never in the YAML. The deploy key file is deleted even if a step fails.

children.title: SSH host verification
children.summary: Deploys record the server's fingerprint with ssh-keyscan instead of turning host checking off.

children.title: HTTPS via Caddy
children.summary: The original deploy was plain HTTP. A re-runnable script adds Caddy with auto TLS for any redeploy, then port 8000 gets closed.

children.title: AWS infra (Terraform)
children.summary: The whole AWS environment is code. It ran on EC2 for about five months, then was retired on purpose; terraform apply recreates it.
children.detail: Not currently hosted. The instance was taken down rather than paying for an idle demo. Locally, docker compose up needs nothing from AWS.

children.title: Ubuntu 22.04 AMI lookup
children.summary: A data source picks the latest official Canonical Ubuntu 22.04 image instead of hardcoding an AMI ID.

children.title: EC2 instance
children.summary: t2.micro in us-east-1. user_data installs Docker, Compose and git on first boot.

children.title: Security group
children.summary: Opens SSH, 80 and 443 for TLS, and 8000 for the app, marked to be removed once Caddy fronts the API.

children.title: SSH key pair
children.summary: Registers the deploy public key with AWS, used by the GitHub Actions deploy.

children.title: Docker Compose stack
children.summary: Postgres 16 plus the app container. The app waits for the database healthcheck before starting.

children.title: CI/CD pipeline
children.summary: Every push to main runs the tests, and only a green test job can deploy. Failing tests leave the server on the last good version.

children.title: Test job
children.summary: Fresh Ubuntu runner, Python 3.11, pip install, pytest. Fake env values satisfy the startup checks.

children.title: Deploy gated on tests
children.summary: needs: test, plus a DEPLOY_TARGET switch so pushes don't fail trying to reach a server that no longer exists.

children.title: SSH deploy to EC2
children.summary: Pulls main, rebuilds only the app container so Postgres keeps running, then curls /health.

children.title: API tests
children.summary: Mocked pytest suite covering every endpoint, so it needs no live database or real FRED calls.

children.title: Read endpoint tests
children.summary: Health check, metrics and alerts, including the empty-result cases.

children.title: Write + auth tests
children.summary: Ingest without a key is rejected, ingest returns fired alerts, thresholds create, update and reject bad bodies.
